verdict.rationale: ROS 2's launch system, managed-lifecycle nodes, and actions for long-running background tasks provide building blocks for autonomous, persistent robot behavior running without a human in the loop, which loosely maps to 'background automations.' However, there is no evidence of AI-native automation setup (e.g., natural-language triggers, scheduling, or agent orchestration) — this is low-level robotics middleware, not an automation/agent platform. Missing for 10: explicit AI-agent or automation-authoring tooling, scheduling/trigger mechanisms, and any framing of 'automations' as a first-class AI-native concept.
